_comment: The agent prompts' lines for one OS (carl_client.domain.merge.for_os): on Windows the line in "posix" of a prompt is replaced by the one in "windows". The prompts in client/agents stay as they are (the benches read them byte for byte, contract C-603), so macOS and Linux keep their text. A test checks that each posix line is in its prompt once.

windows.posix: - Stay inside the project directory. Scratch output (logs, a run's output) goes to `/tmp`, not into the project.
windows.windows: - Stay inside the project directory. Scratch output (logs, a run's output) goes to the temporary folder (`/tmp` in bash, `$env:TEMP` in PowerShell), not into the project.

windows.posix: 1. Start the app yourself with bash, in the background, as the report says (for example `python3 -m http.server 8765 >/dev/null 2>&1 &`). Check that it answers (`curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" URL`). The browser subagent cannot start it.
windows.windows: 1. Start the app yourself with the shell tool, in the background, as the report says (for example `py -m http.server 8765 >/dev/null 2>&1 &` in bash). Check that it answers (`curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" URL`). The browser subagent cannot start it.
